projectDescription: A high-performance infinite canvas drawing application built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript, inspired by Concepts App.
keyFeatures: Infinite canvas with pan, zoom, and rotation
High-performance SVG rendering with canvas overlay for live strokes
12 brush types: Pen, Fountain, Dynamic Pen, Marker, Watercolor, Airbrush, and more
Unlimited layer management with visibility, lock, opacity, and drag-to-reorder
Selection tools: lasso, marquee, translate, scale, rotate
Nudge tool for post-draw stroke point manipulation
Fill tool for closed polygon regions
COPIC color wheel with 69 curated sections plus custom hex input
Auto-save via Tauri backend with compressed project files
Undo/redo history (up to 50 steps) powered by Immer patches
RBush-based spatial index for efficient viewport culling
Persistent state via Zustand with compressed point storage
publicApiSurface: useCanvasStore — Zustand store with all canvas and UI state actions
useCanvasEvents — pointer/wheel event hook for the infinite canvas
useAutoSave — auto-saves canvas state via Tauri invoke at configurable interval
SpatialIndex — RBush-backed spatial index for viewport queries
getSvgPathFromStroke(stroke) — converts perfect-freehand output to SVG path string
BRUSHES — array of 12 BrushItem presets with BrushProperties
Tauri command: save_canvas(canvas, filename) — compress and save project file
Tauri command: load_canvas(filename) — decompress and load project file
Tauri command: list_canvases() — list all saved project files
